proof_summary: Take \(n=33085221781504=2^{14}\cdot4409\cdot458009\), where the three factors are pairwise coprime and the two odd factors are prime. Rewriting the divisor sum as \(a(n)=2\sigma_1(n)-\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma_1(d)\), multiplicativity and prime-power formulas give \(\sigma_1(n)=66183576284700\) and \(\sum_{d\mid n}\sigma_1(d)=132367152569399\), so \(a(n)=1\) although \(n\ne1,12\).
